==Description==
'''BETA v1.8''' was the ninth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 5th of August 2019. It added the [[Turret]] tower, two new maps and three emotes, and other small changes.

As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''BETA v1.8''' has been retroactively applied to this update.

This version encompassed one update, the BETA v1.8.0 update (released 5 August 2019).

==Additions==
===Towers===
*[[Turret]]

===Maps===
*[[Doomspire]]
*[[Crossroads]]

===Emotes===
*[[Mannrobics]]
*[[Smug]]
*[[Rat]]

===Miscellaneous===
*New difficulty system with four difficulties
**Easy (Waves 1-35)
**Normal (Waves 1-50)
**Hard (Waves 1-56)
**Insane (Unfinished, Waves 1-56)
*Map highscores
*Mobile sprint button

==Removals==
*Map difficulty ratings on all maps

==Changes & Bugfixes==
*[[Pyromancer]] fire cooldown increased.
*[[Rocketeer|Rocketer]] placement limit increased from 4 to 5.
*[[Sentry]] buffed.
**Placement limit increased from three to five.
**Default targeting setting changed from ''First'' to ''Strongest''.
**Level 5 hidden detection chance increased from 30% to 100%.
***Teddy bear still has a 30% chance to appear, but is now only cosmetic.
*[[Cowboy]] can now only be obtained in [[End of the Line]] and [[Badlands]] on Normal, Hard and Insane difficulties.
*[[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]] spawned enemies bug fixed.
*Bonus cash at the end of each wave formula changed.
*Security fixes.
